rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Every pronoun/demonstrative resolves inside its own chunk or against a term the same file already named earlier: chunk 2 line 23 "Worktrees are the middle path" reuses "Worktrees", first named chunk 1 line 13; chunk 3 line 51 "../repo-bug-fix" (fence) resolves against "bug/issue-412" named in the same chunk's numbered flow (line 39); chunk 4 lines 55-56 "the bug-fix session"/"the feature session" reuse the worktree names introduced in chunk 3's numbered list (lines 39-41) — a term introduced on an earlier slide and reused, not a violation. Chunk 6 line 86 "the loop" is arc-earned spine vocabulary, established in M1 (`getting-going.md:120` "the loop you just ran was orient → fix → close → compound"), which this reference page sits after (lede line 3: "Optional homework between M1 and M2"). No forward reference, no cross-chunk vague pronoun found.

No chunk points at another file by position. Line 3 "Optional homework between M1 and M2" is a scheduling statement about where THIS file sits, not a narrative callback into another file's content by position — nothing in the body says "the opening lecture said" or equivalent.

Every chunk (1-7) carries multiple paragraphs or a numbered/bulleted list with self-carrying claims. Chunk 7 ("Close", lines 88-91) is shortest at 3 sentences but each sentence adds its own claim (milestone / habit / grown-into); none is a bare wait-state or single context-dependent bullet.

chunk 4 "Stashing and switching between sessions" (lines 54-69): lines 68-69, unchanged since the prior pin — "Agent committed to the wrong branch in one session? Don't tie your brain in knots. `git reset --soft HEAD~1` keeps the changes staged, switch branches, re-commit on the right one. A thirty-second fix." — a wrong-branch-commit recovery tip, not stash/pop mechanics or work moving between sessions. Harm: a reader scanning this header for "how do I fix a wrong-branch commit" would look under the next chunk ("Conflict recovery...") and could miss this tip entirely; the header doesn't literally summarize this closing beat of the chunk, per `check_writing.md §18` extended to the slide unit. Present in the 2026-08-24 instance as the same finding; the two body edits since that pin (lines 80, 86) didn't touch this passage, so the harm is still live.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Give the wrong-branch fix its own short aside, or widen the header to cover session/branch recovery generally.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest candidates: chunk 3 line 44 "Each session has its own scrollback, its own working directory, its own branch" and chunk 2 line 29 "Two folders, two branches, zero checkout churn" are anaphoric/parallel triples, but each leg names a genuinely distinct concrete noun (scrollback / working directory / branch; folders / branches / churn), so they stay inside the "third leg carries new concrete content" exception. Chunk 7 line 90 "Two sessions is a milestone. Five is a habit. Ten is something you grow into." is a three-part parallel structure whose third leg is a distinct, non-formulaic phrase, not filler repetition. No "Not X. Not Y. Z." construction, no self-grading superlative, no number-then-retraction, no abstraction-noun stack, no empty verb-triplet leg found in the body.
